_comment: Base stack profile, applied to every app pair (always the last link of an 'extends' chain). Keep it stack-neutral: only differences that have no visual effect in any browser/framework pair. Fields: roleEquivalences (groups of accessibility roles that are the same thing on both sides), selectorHints (widget part -> selector hints per side, documentation for the planner), accepted (property exact or 'prefix*', optional role / element substring / reference + target value regexes, reason shown in the report as 'accepted by profile <name>: <reason>'), ignoreProperties (never compared by the automatic comparison), ignoreRoles (excluded from the inventory matching). See docs/RUN-TESTING-LIFECYCLE.md 'Adding a stack profile'.
name: generic
description: Stack-neutral equivalences for any web app to web app migration.

accepted.reason: 'start' renders as 'left' on a left-to-right page
empty and 'none' are the same computed value
